description: PRAHARI common interpretation framework. One configuration drives every screen and every API: calibrated PD to a unified Risk Grade, RAG bucket, model-implied SMA-equivalent, IRAC provisioning and a recommended action ladder. Identical scale, colours and words for every MSME loan regardless of type or sector; per-loan-type band overrides are permitted here and nowhere else.

rag.rationale: Calibrated PD means these bands read as odds a banker can check: amber from a 1-in-20 twelve-month default probability, red from 1-in-5. The amber threshold coincides with the bank-90-percent-accuracy operating point on the validation fold.

model_implied_sma.note: Statutory SMA is defined by RBI on days past due (SMA-0: 1-30, SMA-1: 31-60, SMA-2: 61-90). PRAHARI's flag is a MODEL-IMPLIED equivalent derived from behaviour and is always shown beside the statutory status computed from actual DPD. It never replaces it.

irac_provisioning.note: Standard asset 0.40 percent; sub-standard (NPA up to 12 months) 15 percent; restructured standard 5 percent. Provisioning shown on screen is the difference between acting now (standard) and letting the account slip to sub-standard.

crilc.note: CRILC reporting applies to borrowers with aggregate exposure of 5 crore and above. PRAHARI drafts an early-warning note for such accounts; the statutory SMA-2 report itself is triggered by DPD.

actions.detail: Annual review cycle; no action required.
Obtain latest stock and book-debt statements; verify drawing power; fortnightly conduct review; officer call on the promoter.
Unit visit within 15 days; review limits and security; evaluate restructure or reschedule while the account is still standard; draft SMA memo for the credit committee.

Conduct.description: Utilisation and drawing-power discipline, repayment record, cheque returns, liens, stock-statement submission (IDBI APIs 402, 441, 362, 393)

Compliance.description: GST filing timeliness and EPFO remittance discipline

Activity.description: Real operations: credit turnover, electricity, fuel, headcount trends

External.description: Bureau behaviour with other lenders and sector sentiment (IDBI API 408)

Promoter profile.description: Loan type, sector, size, vintage, promoter experience and qualification, the dimensions IDBI named for a unified score

Officer notes.description: Unstructured: sentiment and risk themes extracted from free-text officer observations

Contagion.description: Anchor-attributable inflow dependence and trend (statement credits grouped by payer)
